remainingCoverage.reason: This profile does not establish a distinct privileged keyring or privileged authorization lifecycle.
No supported native UI for selecting finite grant expiry is exercised; neither clocks nor private grant stores are changed.
Public CWI observations do not establish every BRC wire encoding or framing requirement.

predecessor.retainedResults: Policy1, policy2 and their original observations remain unchanged.

revisionRationale.exactCap: The grouped manifest grants a fixed 100-satoshi monthly cap before any payments. The three accepted output amounts are 11, 13 and 7 satoshis. The independent verifier derives each fee from retained signed transaction inputs minus all outputs and requires the three payments plus their actual fees to total exactly 100. At 23 satoshis per fee, the total is 34+36+30=100. Any other actual total fails this case; the cap and payment amounts are never adapted after execution. The exact trusted revocation-card snapshot must independently show cap100, spent100 and remaining0; internally consistent UI arithmetic alone does not establish agreement with the signed ledger.
revisionRationale.uiObservation: Before revocation, wait for the expanded standing-allowance card to show the exact cap, spent amount and consistent remaining balance, then capture a stable body/card pair. Require exact beforeBody equality with the trusted click; no normalization or ignored suffix.
revisionRationale.sutBoundary: All three accepted payments must settle with no new permission prompt, including the third payment at the exact cap. The 53, 59, 61 and 67-satoshi denied markers and recipient remain unchanged. The 7-satoshi accepted payment uses the coverage recipient key 68, distinct from the legacy 7-satoshi denial marker. No private grant store, wallet clock or post-outcome allowance is changed.
